title: Build a Deep Neural Network from Scratch in PyTorch
core_invariant: A neural network is an end-to-end differentiable computational graph optimized via the chain rule.

stages.title: PyTorch Autograd Architecture
stages.instructions: Understand how PyTorch constructs dynamic computation graphs and tracks gradients.

stages.title: Learning Rate vs Loss Surface Experiment
stages.instructions: Predict loss convergence behavior for learning rates [1e-1, 1e-3, 1e-5] before running 10 epochs.

stages.title: Diagnose Exploding Gradients
stages.instructions: The model outputs NaN loss at epoch 3. Inspect gradient norms, identify the exploding layer, and implement gradient clipping.

stages.title: No-AI MLP Implementation Challenge
stages.instructions: Implement a 3-layer MLP with BatchNorm and Dropout on a fresh multi-class classification problem without AI assistance.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Validation accuracy > 88% and loss monotonically decreases.
